nodes.label: ADR 0184: Turn off the folder repair in Engine DJ's databases
nodes.rationale: After GLUE Home 0.74.0 repaired Engine DJ's folder structure, Engine DJ locked all playlists. Root cause unknown despite intact chains and clean SQLite integrity. Decision: disable dj_fix_folders in 0.74.1, keep code for investigation, user restores backups. Lesson: inferred database changes must be tested in Engine DJ itself before shipping.
